62.description: This feature vector activates strongly on Hindi characters and Devanagari script components.

104.description: This feature vector activates on Hindi vowel sign matras attached to punctuation marks or commas.

122.description: This vector represents common Hindi noun and verb suffixes as well as sub-word inflectional tokens.

45.description: This vector activates for Hindi verb roots, suffixes, and inflectional endings.

146.description: These tokens represent various consonant characters and phonemes from the Devanagari script and Latin alphabet.

118.description: This feature vector activates on common Hindi sub-word tokens and syllable fragments.

50.description: These tokens represent Hindi nasalization diacritics and vowel-modifier signs (Anusvara and Chandrabindu variants).

172.description: This vector represents Hindi vowel signs and dependent vowel modifiers attached to consonants.

60.description: This feature vector represents random noise, punctuation marks, and disconnected characters from mixed scripts without a cohesive semantic theme.

44.description: This feature vector activates on common suffixes and vowel signs characteristic of South Asian and Latin-derived scripts.
